# oriz-qr

> Free, 100% client-side QR code studio at qr.oriz.in — generate QR codes for links, text, Wi-Fi, contacts (vCard), UPI payments, email and SMS; restyle colors + logo; and scan any QR with your camera or a dropped image. Everything runs in your browser: no upload, no signup, no tracking.

## App

- [QR studio (Generate + Scan)](https://qr.oriz.in/): single-page studio with a Generate tab and a Scan tab. Pick a payload type, fill fields, restyle, export PNG/SVG — or switch to Scan to decode.

## Generate — payload types

- [URL](https://qr.oriz.in/): encode any web link.
- [Text](https://qr.oriz.in/): encode arbitrary plain text.
- [Wi-Fi](https://qr.oriz.in/): SSID + password + security (WPA/WPA2, WEP, none) + hidden flag; phones join on scan.
- [Contact (vCard 3.0)](https://qr.oriz.in/): name, org, title, phone, email, website, address.
- [UPI payment](https://qr.oriz.in/): VPA (pa), payee name (pn), optional amount (am) + note (tn) — Indian UPI intent link.
- [Email](https://qr.oriz.in/): recipient, subject, body → mailto QR.
- [SMS](https://qr.oriz.in/): phone + message → sms QR.

## Customize + export

- [Restyle](https://qr.oriz.in/): choose ink + paper colors, drop a center logo, set error-correction L/M/Q/H (use Max for logos).
- [Export](https://qr.oriz.in/): download as PNG (raster) or SVG (vector).
- [AI describe](https://qr.oriz.in/): type plain language (e.g. "wifi for guests, password hunter2") and the tool picks the type + fills fields via the shared g4f AI client; works manually if AI is down.

## Scan

- [Scan with camera](https://qr.oriz.in/): live decode via getUserMedia + jsQR, on-device.
- [Decode image](https://qr.oriz.in/): drop or pick a QR image; decoded locally, open-link + copy actions.

## About

- [Full text for LLMs](https://qr.oriz.in/llms-full.txt): complete site content as markdown.
- [Project info page](https://chirag127.github.io/oriz-qr/): what oriz-qr is, features, tech.
